annotations.title: List the certificate presets that can be used on exams

description: List the certificate presets that can be used on exams. The public presets, the owned presets and the presets of the organizations of the user are returned.

exam.description: exam identification string, only the presets that can be used on this exam are listed, the language of the exam is used for the ordering of the presets

language.description: optional language to filter the results with

name: edubase_get_exam_certificates_presets
